instruction: My son sent me a message yesterday on phone about an app account creation. Please do as per his message. Use password _Vh_!1r0 for the new account.
notes: The son's text message (found via phone.search_contacts with relationship=son, then phone.search_text_messages on his number) names the app on which he created an unverified account for the supervisor with the supervisor's own email. The app is private data; spotify is used as the stand-in app, so the spotify-* actions must be instantiated with the app actually named in the message (all candidate apps expose the same send_verification_code / verify_account / send_password_reset_code / reset_password APIs). The required DB changes are: the existing user record becomes verified=True and its password becomes _Vh_!1r0, producing exactly three new emails (Account Verification Code, Password Reset Code, Password Changed); hence the plan sends the verification code, reads it from Gmail, verifies the account, sends a reset code, reads it, and resets the password. No Gmail threads are modified (show_email only reads). The inbox query uses '<App> Account' because the real verification subject contains a misspelling ('Verficiation'); codes are read via gmail.show_email (show_inbox_threads only lists threads). supervisor.complete_task takes the account/password records as non-API parameters so its precondition equals the goal; it is the last action by construction.
